subject: Exporting or printing the descriptive table

messages.author: c377c26d68a79188
messages.subject: Exporting or printing the descriptive table
parts:
Hello,

When exporting or printing the descriptive table using "print" function or "export2" functions like export2md, appears "Summary descriptives table by groups of `variable_name’"

I would like to know if it's possible to erase this first line?

Thank you !

messages.author: e4c3fc328ba9081e
messages.subject: Re: Exporting or printing the descriptive table
parts: In order to erase this message or title, you must specify the argument caption="", in export2xxx, or print functions.
